units: GLB own units (unitless; this standard-model output is about 1.9 on its longest side, i.e. roughly twice the scale of the smart-topology assets). Origin is the bounding-box centre: lift by -bbox_min[1].
orientation: Y up. Porch, steps and dormer face +Z; chimney toward -X; pennant pole stands on the rear roof slope toward +X/-Z and the pennant flies toward +X.

reference_image.prompt: Use the attached image as the art-style reference (stylized 3D CGI, smooth slightly clay-like surfaces, bright saturated toy-like colours, chunky thick-edged shapes). Create a NEW reference image for 3D modelling of ONE single building, like the top-left building of the reference: a chunky wooden farmhouse headquarters with cream-white plank walls, a ROYAL BLUE shingled roof with one small dormer, a grey stone chimney, a small wooden porch with steps, warm yellow windows, and a plain royal blue pennant on a wooden pole rising from the roof. Clean saturated royal blue is used ONLY on the roof and the pennant and nowhere else. Three-quarter view from slightly above. No grass base, no bushes, no crates, no fence, no rocks. Whole building including the pennant in frame, centred, margin all around. Plain pure white background, flat even studio lighting, no ground, no cast shadow, no other objects, no text, no emblem on the pennant.
